author: NuclearDucky
body:
Alright, first things first, sorry if I'm not suppose to be trying to appeal warns. This warn is completely invalid, and I'll explain why. Also, this warn is very old, so sorry about bringing it up now.
https://avicus.net/infractions/107846

On a game of Sandstorm, my friend and I were having a fist fight. As I knocked him out of the world with my fist, I said "lol I fisted you xD"  then got a /warn for language.

At first I had no idea what Tel was talking about, but then I realized he thought of it in the completely wrong way. I realize it isn't possible too get proof for this! but I just thought I'd try my chances. Thanks for your time, I'll be happy with whatever answer I get!
